feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: 'The 101 Plays Itself': This computer program treats the interstate into music
entry.summary: A Southern California man has created a system which translates cars passing on Interstates in California into soothing music.

entry.title: U.S. military forces formally left Iraq today, marking a new era
entry.summary: The U.S. military has been in Iraq for much of the past 35 years. A low-key ceremony Wednesday marked the formal departure of U.S. forces at a time when Iraq is still facing an uncertain future.

entry.title: How WNBA star Gabby Williams carries her $1 billion team
entry.summary: The Golden State Valkyries lead their playoff series 1-0 after the heroics of Gabby Williams. The former UConn star has one of the WNBA's latest expansion teams playing with incredible team chemistry.

entry.title: Hegseth speech leans on culture war flashpoints
entry.summary: Against the backdrop of an unpopular war in Iran, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave a "State of the Force" speech announcing new autonomous warfare initiatives and leaned on culture war flashpoints.

entry.title: She devoted two books to Greek life. Here's what to consider before pledging
entry.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with journalist Alexandra Robbins about the role the Greek systems play in causing harm on college campuses, and what they should be doing to keep students safe.

entry.title: High diesel prices hit hard in Wyoming
entry.summary: The Cowboy State runs on diesel, and is facing some of the highest prices in America for it.

entry.title: Meta's Muse: Killer app? Security nightmare? Both?
entry.summary: Meta's AI Assistant has been downloaded millions of times. It could change the way we experience the internet, it'll just need a whole lot of your personal data first.

entry.title: Dramatic attack in cockpit of plane bound for Israel
entry.summary: Israel says a FlyDubai co-pilot tried to crash plane full of Israelis after stabbing the captain in the cockpit.

entry.title: John Wilson's revenge against Hollywood? A documentary about concrete
entry.summary: Documentarian John Wilson, known for his HBO show How To with John Wilson, is out with his first feature length documentary on what might seem like a rather dense subject: The History of Concrete.

entry.title: Massachusetts residents compete to be the 'Voice of Logan' airport
entry.summary: A contest is giving Massachusetts residents a chance to become the new voice of Boston Logan International Airport. With thousands of entries, the competition is wicked steep.
